findings.message: LDAP Filter Injection risk (CWE-90): User-supplied input is interpolated directly into an LDAP search filter string without escaping LDAP metacharacters ('*', '(', ')', '\\', NUL), allowing attackers to bypass authentication or enumerate records (e.g. 'admin)(|(uid=*'). Reject or escape special LDAP filter characters in user input.
